input_sources: canonical BIF files via flux_discover_files() (see file_name list in table_5_provenance.csv)
notes: One row per current-network site (n=781). p_era_mean_mm: mean of YY-resolution P_ERA over its full ERA5 record (all non-NA years, typically ~1981-2025). p_measured_mean_mm: mean of YY-resolution P_F over years where P_F_QC > QC_THRESHOLD_YY (0.5, the existing pipeline-wide coarse-resolution QC threshold from R/pipeline_config.R), NOT the NEE-based row exclusion in annual_qc/04_qc.R (that targets flux variables, not precipitation). bio12_mm: WorldClim v2.1 BIO12 at the tower cell (data/snapshots/site_worldclim.csv, 2026-09-01, static raster). badm_map_mm/elevation_m/oneflux_code_version: freshly extracted from each site's currently-canonical BIF file (flux_discover_files()-deduplicated, i.e. post-2026-09-20-refresh where applicable), NOT from data/processed/badm.rds (built 2026-06-02, predates the refresh for several re-extracted sites). Annual resolution only throughout; DD/MM/HH FLUXMET/ERA5 files were not read for this table.
